Given the tools, I should probably list orders first to map order IDs to customer IDs, although 'list_orders' is the tool available for order information.

I need to calculate the net balance for 'acme' (from 220 and 223) and 'cobalt' (from 222). The task requires me to use `net_balance(customer)` to get the figure, not calculate it myself. I will call `net_balance` for 'acme' and 'cobalt'.

I have the net balance for 'acme': 25415 cents. Now I need the net balance for 'cobalt' based on the refunded orders (222 and 223). Wait, the refund for 223 was for 'acme', not 'cobalt'. The customers involved are 'acme' and 'cobalt'. I already got 'acme'. Now I need 'cobalt'.

Since all refunds were verified and net balances are obtained, I can now record the payouts for both customers. I will record one payout per customer. I will process them sequentially.
